messages:
jules: PM asked for 'per-customer insight cards' in Console: noisy neighbor heatmap, routing/policy visibility, and quota breach timeline. Can infra/runtime teams weigh in on what we can expose safely? cc @marta @anand

marta: We can surface per-org aggregates. Important: no raw request bodies or PII. Existing metrics pipeline has request_count and latency by model, but not labeled with org_id at high cardinality. We need selective labeling.

anand: Agree. Adding org label to hot metrics will increase cardinality. Proposal: tag only four metrics at high-cardinality: request_count, tokens_processed, p95_latency_ms, cache_hit_rate. Other metrics remain global/top-level.

product-elena: From UX: product wants toggle per-org to enable richer diagnostics (on by customer opt-in). Also want routing policy column showing active policy and fallback counts.

sam: We should also include committed capacity/quota for Dedicated customers and visible throttles for Hosted. That helps SRE and support.

marta: On the runtime side we'll emit: route, model_variant, org (opt-in), batch_size, queue_len. Suggest label format: org_hash (sha256 short). We will avoid sending org raw ids.

anand: For noisy-neighbor detection, algorithm idea: sustained increase in p95/p50 ratio > 3x for > 5 minutes AND queue_len growth + increased fallback_count. We'll compute a 'noisy_score' that combines z-score of p95 and derivative of queue_len.

sre-bot: auto-alert: noisy_score(org_hash) > 2.5 -> post to #incidents and create ticket.

jules: That sounds good. UX question: how granular should the heatmap be? per-minute? per-5min?

product-elena: per-1min for active tenants, roll-up to 5m for long-term. Need to control retention/cost.

sam: Also need to show 'routing policy' attribution: which route handled the request (fast lane, low-cost, fallback). We have route tags in runtime; expose counts by route per org.

marta: Implementation note: we'll add a metrics switch per-org (CustomerSettings.metrics_diagnostic = true). Default false to avoid cardinality blow-up.

anand: Dashboard queries: example PromQL:
```promql
sum(rate(request_count_total{org_hash="<hash>",route!=""}[1m])) by (route)
sum_over_time((p95_latency_ms{org_hash="<hash>"}[5m]))
```

marta: We'll also emit tokens_processed_total{org_hash="<hash>",model="..."} for cost estimates.

product-elena: For Console, widgets: 1) Heatmap of noisy_score over time, 2) Table of top routes with p95/throughput, 3) Quota bar + throttle timeline, 4) 'Recent fallbacks' list.

jules: Permissions: only organization admins and support with access should see these. Audit log when a tenant metrics toggle is enabled.

sam: Support wants a per-org 'snapshot' export (csv) for troubleshooting. Need privacy review.

marta: I'll start a runtime PR to add labels and a flag. Will mock telemetry ingestion changes. ETA: PR by 2026-04-02.

anand: I'll draft dashboard queries and alert rules. ETA: 2026-04-06.

product-elena: I'll attach mockups and a small permission flow. ETA: 2026-04-05.

jules: Thanks all — linking product ticket PROD-5621. If anyone has blockers ping me.
